review_description: Bunya are fantastic to deal with. They examined all our needs and tried to undersell, rather than oversell the installation. They were only interested in installing the size of system we needed. They have installed many systems in our valley, and come highly recommended by everyone.

Clay and luke have done several updates and modifications (new panels and inverter ,rewiring etc) and i have found them to be efficient , on time and reasonable  , they are more  than competive  price wise  and would be happy to have them back for any other work i might have.

We went with Bunya Solar - good service, local company, plenty of local reference sites and excellent price. They recommended two groups of Trina panels with Enphase micro inverters, with provision to add panels if monitoring shows we are consuming all of what we generate.

Only received one call after our contact, who didn't  do stand alone systems . Heard about Bunya Solar from local recommendation .Business proprietor Clay Stafford was incredibly informative &  obliging.he was an efficient system designer, provided good alternatives  & simplified the process wonderfully well. Whole process from first contact to installation took 17 days. I couldn't recommend  these guys more highly
In a small community it is important to keep the money local, which in turn helps our community.
